objective: Validate Deck A and Volume A on the real Windows browser/audio device before promotion.
scope: Do not build Deck B, SYNC, loops, EQ, waveform, or other higher modules.
Do not patch product/system code from validation/local-debug.
steps: Check out the exact requested SHA and run python bootstrap.py; require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install and npm run check.
Start Vite with the repository configuration and open the app in headed Edge/Chrome on the physical Windows audio device.
Load the generated/synthetic test path and confirm Deck A play, pause, seek, rate, volume, mute, and end-of-track behavior are audible and match status.
Load at least one ordinary local audio file if available through the Deck A file control; record its format, decoded channel count/sample rate/duration, and whether playback is clean.
Confirm volume can be swept from 1.0 to 0.0 and back without obvious zipper noise or transport interruption.
Confirm mute/unmute is clean and does not change source-frame position semantics.
Run playback at 0.5x, 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x; confirm varispeed behavior is intentional and transport remains stable.
Perform at least 25 mixed transport operations: play/pause/seek/rate/volume/mute while watching status for state mismatch.
Run the provided 600 ms main-thread stress while Deck A is playing; record before/after outputCurrentFrame, sourceFrame, and frameDiscontinuities and listen for dropout.
Run continuous Deck A playback for at least 5 minutes on a track or generated signal long enough to cover the interval; report dropouts, clicks, exceptions, or state stalls.
Write reports/local-debug/LATEST.json, ENVIRONMENT.json, SESSION_LOG.md, and small artifacts if useful on validation/local-debug, then push.
evidence_required: AudioContext sample rate, base/output latency, render quantum.
Decoder provider and decoded PCM metadata for each tested source.
600 ms main-thread stress frame deltas and new discontinuities.
stop_conditions: Stop BLOCKED if bootstrap or exact SHA checkout fails.
Stop FAIL if decoded PCM cannot load or physical audio cannot be produced.
Do not modify product/system code from validation/local-debug.
